digest.overview: Big-ticket compute and funding deals dominated the morning: Nvidia's reported $5B SSI commitment, Recursive's $410M Amazon pact, and Fish Audio's $50M seed. Perplexity pushed its agentic PC tool to Windows while Hugging Face faced fresh reporting on nonconsensual deepfake abuse of its models.

top_story.headline: Nvidia invests $5B in Ilya Sutskever's SSI
top_story.summary: Nvidia announced a long-term strategic partnership with Safe Superintelligence Inc., with the chipmaker committing $5B as part of the deal.
top_story.why_it_matters: Largest single external bet yet on a post-OpenAI superintelligence lab; signals hyperscaler willingness to fund closed, high-capability research at scale.

sentiment.label: mixed
sentiment.summary: Funding momentum and agent tooling expansions keep bulls engaged, but deepfake misuse stories on major open platforms and questions around closed-model acceleration create visible pushback in community threads.

frontier_labs.headline: Fish Audio raises $50M seed for AI voice models
frontier_labs.summary: Startup now serves 8M+ users with open-source and hosted models, generating $21M ARR.

frontier_labs.headline: Recursive Superintelligence signs $410M compute deal with Amazon
frontier_labs.summary: Outlay represents the bulk of the company's fundraising to date for its superintelligence push.

frontier_labs.headline: Perplexity expands Personal Computer AI agent tool to Windows
frontier_labs.summary: Windows version lets users run locally-hosted agentic AI systems on the dominant desktop OS, following April Mac launch.

post_ideas.hook: Nvidia just dropped $5B on Ilya’s new lab
post_ideas.draft: Nvidia committing $5B to Ilya Sutskever’s SSI is the clearest signal yet that the biggest players are willing to fund closed superintelligence bets at hyperscale.
post_ideas.why_viral: High-stakes name + dollar amount creates instant tension between open vs closed camps

post_ideas.hook: Hugging Face models powering nonconsensual deepfakes
post_ideas.draft: New report shows top image-editing models on HF are being used to undress women and children with almost no friction. Platform response remains minimal.
post_ideas.why_viral: Direct safety failure on the most popular open repo; easy to verify and share

post_ideas.hook: Perplexity now ships agentic AI to every Windows PC
post_ideas.draft: Perplexity’s Personal Computer tool just landed on Windows, turning the world’s most common desktop into a locally runnable AI agent platform.
post_ideas.why_viral: Practical reach: suddenly millions more machines can run agent workflows without new hardware
